text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted runtime node group 'h-runtime-prod' reporting repeated OOMs. Metric spike in 'kv_cache_size_bytes' and 'batch_window_ms'. Paging on-call.

sara_sre: I'm taking this. seeing KV cache jump from ~28GB -> 390GB across 4 replicas in the last 7m.

matt_sre: confirmed. OOMs started at ~2475029945. Root cause looks like runaway context expansion from a subset of requests (long-prompt customers).

jin_runtime: do we have a quick mitigation? can we throttle prefetch or disable async prefetch for hosted-tier?

clare_prod: multiple customers reporting slow/failed streaming responses, 3 active incidents from support queue referencing timeouts. tagging affected tenants in the incident board.

alex_support: customer A / tenant-312 noticed sessions with 600k token contexts. They say the client-side concatenation bug started yesterday.

 sara_sre: mitigation plan: 1) enable conservative prefetch cap (prefetch_multiplier=0.05) 2) reduce continuous batching window from 200ms -> 40ms 3) temporarily disable cross-session KV prefetching for hosted. will push config change to staging then prod if green.

matt_sre: +1. add immediate safety: evict-kvcache-old-entries for any scope > 256k tokens. run eviction tool now.

jin_runtime: applying throttle via runtime config API now. command: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://control.redwood.internal/runtime/config -d '{"prefetch_multiplier":0.05,"batch_window_ms":40,"cross_session_prefetch":false}'```

oncall_bot: Handoff notice: sara_sre -> matt_sre at 2475030180 (30m). On-call escalation path notified.

 dave_infra: I pushed a hotpatch to the autoscaler to avoid provisioning smaller instances that would be more susceptible to OOM under KV surge. also increased soft ulimit for process RSS on h-runtime-prod nodes.

 sara_sre: eviction ran. KV cache reduced from 390GB -> 45GB on primaries. OOMs stopped on 3/4 replicas; one replica shows repeated GC spikes, draining it for further inspection.

 clare_prod: customer impact summary: ~12 tenants saw degraded responses, 2 had streaming disconnects; no data loss. support notified customers B and C that throttles are in place pending client fix.

 alex_support: customers acknowledged temporary throttling, one asked for ETA on rollback of mitigations. recommended follow-up: notify when continuous batching window is restored and cross-session prefetch resumed.

 matt_sre: action items: (a) postmortem owning -> sara_sre, (b) patch: add per-tenant prefetch budget + circuit-breaker, (c) follow-up infra: enforce KV cache size limits per-host, (d) outreach to affected customers. I'll take on (b)+(d).

 jin_runtime: quick note to engineering: we should ship a guard in runtime to abort prefetch when input token count > 100k. filing runtime PR after handoff.```
